title: Viewport render fidelity and touch-interaction sweep for UI kit (Safari/Firefox/mobile)
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Scope: This ticket coordinates a focused QA sweep of the UI kit components and tokens across Safari (macOS & iOS), Firefox (desktop), and common mobile WebViews (iOS Safari, Chrome on Android). The goal is to identify rendering fidelity regressions, layout shifts at responsive breakpoints, and touch/interaction regressions introduced since the token overhaul (color aliasing and spacing scale changes). Components in scope: buttons, primary/secondary forms, tables with sticky headers, responsive data tables, line/area charts (canvas and SVG variants), and global tokens (color, elevation, spacing, type).

Background: After the token rename + density changes landed in runtime-1.22, multiple surface-level visual diffs were reported by partners. This ticket consolidates known issues, adds reproducible test steps, and triages fixes with engineering and platform QA.

Outcomes expected: a prioritized bug list with reproduction steps, owner assignments (design/engineering), short-term workarounds for product teams, and a verification checklist to add to the UI-kit release process.
acceptance_criteria: Repro steps recorded for each reported bug with at least one video or screenshot
Priority assigned and owner designated for every bug (P0/P1/P2)
Fix PR(s) or design spec adjustments linked, or documented workaround if fix will be in a later release
Verification checklist added to the Design System release playbook and marked as reviewed
All P0/P1 visual regressions either resolved or scheduled with clear rollback/fallback plan
bugs_found: BK-001: iOS Safari - Primary button text baseline shifts when using system-font stack; subpixel rounding causes 1px vertical offset between icon and label (repro: iPhone 14 Pro, 15/16px body size). Priority: P1. Assigned: ENG-9487.

BK-002: macOS Safari - Color alias --surface-foreground renders slightly lower contrast than computed value due to color-srgb conversion on Safari; affects disabled button and chip states. Priority: P2. Assigned: ENG-9521.
BK-003: Firefox desktop - Table sticky header clips at 1024px width with grid-layout tables; overflow: clip on container is enforced. Repro: Firefox 121 on Ubuntu. Priority: P1. Assigned: ENG-9563.

BK-004: Android Chrome WebView - Double-tap causes unexpected zoom for components with -webkit-touch-callout and viewport meta missing; small hit targets for table row actions. Priority: P2. Assigned: ENG-9600.
BK-005: Canvas charts - High-DPI devices show blurred axis labels when devicePixelRatio >= 2; SVG variant is crisp. Priority: P1. Assigned: ENG-9612.
BK-006: macOS VoiceOver - Focus order for compact form field + helper text is inconsistent in Safari; screen reader reads helper before input. Priority: P2. Assigned: ENG-9578.

BK-007: All browsers - Token elevation (shadow) values pull in CSS variable fallback incorrectly in nested components; nested card uses parent token value instead of local alias. Priority: P1. Assigned: ENG-9634.
BK-008: iPad Safari - Touch target for small icon-only buttons is under 44x44 px at tablet breakpoint when density=compact. Priority: P1. Assigned: Product (PM-412) + ENG-9650.
BK-009: Firefox - CSS flexbox rounding causes 1px gap between pill components in horizontal lists at fractional rem sizes. Priority: P3. Assigned: ENG-9661.
BK-010: macOS Safari - Autofill background color for inputs ignores CSS appearance reset and shows native yellow; conflicts with token surface color. Priority: P2. Assigned: ENG-9680.
triage_notes: 2026-03-06: Initial sweep by design (Priya) and QA (Jordan) identified 10 reproducible issues. Screenshots and short screen recordings uploaded to the QA Drive folder.

2026-03-07: Triage call with runtime and frontend infra teams. Decided to prioritize token elevation and button baseline regressions (BK-001, BK-007) because they affect multiple product screens. Agreed short-term workaround: add a small utility class (.kit-fix-baseline) for hotfix in Dedicated customers while a runtime patch is built.

2026-03-09: Engineering requested exact font metric values and the Figma spec snapshot. Design exported metric tokens (cap-height, baseline-grid) and attached to Figma variant 'Buttons / Baseline-stable v2'.

2026-03-10: Charts blur (BK-005) root cause narrowed to canvas scaling logic; ENG-9612 to propose devicePixelRatio-aware canvas renderer. Temporary recommendation: use SVG variant for dashboards with critical numeric labels.

2026-03-11: Accessibility lead (Rafael Ortiz) confirmed VoiceOver repro on macOS Safari; assigned pair to reproduce + patch. Rafael requesting a minimal HTML test case to include in a11y regression suite.
2026-03-12: Added verification checklist for each bug (repro steps, env, expected vs observed, screenshots). Planning verification pass week of 2026-03-15 after patch PRs land.
repro_steps_and_env: General: Use latest nightly of each browser where applicable; clear caches and disable browser extensions that alter CSS (e.g., dark reader, style manipulators).

BK-001 repro: Open Primary button component playground on iPhone 14 Pro (iOS 17.2) Safari -> Orientation Portrait -> set font size to default -> compare label vertical position with icon. Video: drive.redwood/qa/des-23104/bk001.mp4
BK-003 repro: Desktop Firefox 121 (Ubuntu 22.04) -> open data table demo -> resize width to 1024px -> scroll vertically -> observe header clipping. Screenshot: drive.redwood/qa/des-23104/bk003.png
BK-005 repro: Chrome (macOS) and iPhone simulator -> open chart canvas demo -> check axis labels at DPR 2 and 3. Attach canvas image and SVG image for comparison.
workarounds: Button baseline: Add .kit-fix-baseline utility on pages where icon+label buttons are critical; small vertical transform (-0.5px) to align on Safari. Short-term only.
Charts: Recommend using SVG variant in dashboards until canvas DPR patch rolls out. Update dashboard templates to prefer SVG when numeric labels must remain sharp.
Sticky table: Use position: -webkit-sticky fallback with explicit top values for Safari; engineering to add cross-browser helper mixin in tokens package.
